**The current Stage A contract is a different experiment.** The selected 25-task MultiLang corpus remains a pinned historical input, but the amended executable screen uses **23 reviewed archive tasks**, seven standard arms, one repetition and **161 scheduled slots**. Two validator-unresolved tasks were dropped without replacement; the prepared-environment release retains the 23 tasks, validators and order. The README’s opening “25-task” shorthand—and older 25-task/175-slot planning passages—should not be read as overriding that amendment ([`docs/contracts/staged-multilang-benchmark-v5.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/contracts/staged-multilang-benchmark-v5.md), “Stage A — screening cohort”; [`docs/authoritative/adr/0016-screen-stage-a-on-23-reviewed-tasks.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/authoritative/adr/0016-screen-stage-a-on-23-reviewed-tasks.md); [`docs/releases/stage-a-prepared-23-v1.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/releases/stage-a-prepared-23-v1.md)).

A comparative run requires its **own** exact, owner-approved numerical freeze: archive/corpus and verifier identities, all seven freshly admitted arm/runtime/research identities, policy, finite window, resources and reservations, seeded complete schedule and outcome-slot plan. The continuous cohort must use one ledger and admitted configuration, reconcile every slot, then receive a full offline audit, Stage A seal and separate published report/disposition. Earlier Glaze blocks and stopped cohort attempts are not a prefix to substitute for that cohort ([`docs/contracts/staged-multilang-benchmark-v5.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/contracts/staged-multilang-benchmark-v5.md), “Executable freeze boundary,” “Stage A,” and “Screening report”; [`docs/runbooks/stage-a-continuous-cohort.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/runbooks/stage-a-continuous-cohort.md), “What the harness enforces”; [`docs/authoritative/adr/0016-screen-stage-a-on-23-reviewed-tasks.md`](agent-harness-evals/docs/authoritative/adr/0016-screen-stage-a-on-23-reviewed-tasks.md)).

**Still unverified by the qualification:** a sealed, published 161-slot comparative screen; a precise ordering of seven arms; run-to-run reliability from a one-repetition screen; or a Stage B/RelayView comparison. Stage A’s prospective futility test is applied per arm only after its 23 slots reconcile: `resolved + capability_unknown + unstarted <= 1` is an absolute near-total-failure stop, **not** a ranking or proof of general inferiority.
